title: 'Phantom Busters' Announces Main Cast, Staff
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shoco 's Phantom Busters manga revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Cast Mogari Shishikuno: Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Eugene Korekishi: Natsuki Hanae ( Kimetsu no Yaiba ) Kaoru Kanzaki: Kouki Uchiyama ( Horimiya ) Koutarou Tamon: Ryouta Suzuki ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai )

Staff Director: Chika Nagaoka ( Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? ) Character Design: Takahiro Kishida ( Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica ), Rina Iwamoto ( Akuma no Memumemu-chan ) Studio: TOHO animation STUDIO

Shoco originally drew the supernatural comedy manga as a one-shot in Jump SQ.Rise magazine in October 2022. The manga began serializing in Jump SQ. magazine in August 2023. Shueisha published the eighth volume on October 2.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in April 2025 and released the fifth volume on October 6. The sixth volume is scheduled for a January 2027 release. Shueisha's Manga Plus platform also simulpublishes the manga in English.

title: Pokémon Unite Game Ends Service on March 23, 2027
content:
The staff for the Pokémon Unite game announced on Tuesday that the game will end its service on March 23, 2027 for both the Nintendo Switch and mobile device versions. The game has already suspended the sales of the in-game Aeos gem currency, new UNITE Club membership purchases, and automatic membership renewals on Tuesday.

The game's staff stated that the Pokémon Unite Aeos Crown 2027 Tokyo tournament will still be held as previously announced, with qualifier tournaments starting on December 5. Special event and update leading up to the game's end of service will start on November 12. The update will include a "library" feature, which will allow players to view certain records and in-game content. Players have to complete the required library data download before the game ends service to be able to use the feature.

The game launched for Nintendo Switch on July 21, 2021 and then launched on iOS and Android devices on September 22, 2021. Tencent 's TiMi Studio Group produced the game in collaboration with The Pokémon Company.

The game is the franchise 's first strategic team-based battle game. The game allows 10 players to participate in 5-on-5 real-time battles, and it supports cross-platform play. Each team has five goals that they use to catch Pokémon and score points. Captured Pokémon can defeat other Pokémon to level up and learn attacks. Each Pokémon has its own special Unite move that players can unlock when they reach a certain level. The team that scores the most points during the time limit wins. The free-to-start game includes in-app purchases.

The game announced in June an original live-action short project to commemorate the game's fifth anniversary this year.
author: ANN

title: 'Ashita no Joe' Manga Artist Tetsuya Chiba Dies at 87
content:
Tetsuya Chiba , best known as the artist for the Ashita no Joe ( Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow ) manga, died on October 27. He was 87.

Born in Tokyo in January 1993, Chiba made his professional debut with Fukushuu no Semushi in 1956. Following the end of World War II, he returned to Japan with his family after spending childhood in Manchuria, northeastern China.

Chiba drew manga for various magazines early in his career. In January 1967, he began drawing for Ikki Kajiwara 's Ashita no Joe manga in Weekly Shounen Magazine , which ran until May 1973. Kodansha published the 20th and final volume in June that year. The manga sold a cumulative 25 million copies.

Chiba also wrote and illustrated combat sports manga Ore wa Teppei in Weekly Shounen Magazine between August 1973 and April 1980. He simultaneously serialized the long-running sumo manga Notari Matsutarou in Big Comic magazine from July 1973 to April 1999. He later drew the golf manga Ashita Tenki ni Naare in Weekly Shounen Magazine from October 1980 to May 1991.

Chiba's latest serialization, Hinemosu Notari Nikki , began in Big Comic magazine in December 2015. Shogakukan published the seventh and latest volume in November 2025.

Chiba was awarded the Kodansha Culture Award and the Shogakukan Manga Award in 1976 and 1978, respectively. In 2018, he received the Special Prize at the 22nd Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize for Hinemosu Notari Nikki .

title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film's Clip Shows Festival Concert
content:
The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga began streaming a clip from the film on Tuesday. The clip shows the Ietani family performing a concert at their school's cultural festival. The clip features the original song "Kizuna."

Viz Media and MANGA Plus are both publishing the series in English digitally, and MANGA Plus describes the story:

Spring is in the air, and Kotaro is about to begin his first year of high school. He's full of hope and anticipation of a wonderful life at his new school, only to have his dreams crushed by...his family?! Isobe Isobee Monogatari ~ Ukiyo wa Tsuraiyo creator Ryō Nakama 's latest series combines family and school life gags, making it feel familiar but also fresh and new. This new genre of comedy will be sure to make the grade!

The film stars:

• Yuno Nagao (live-action Golden Kamuy, 2024's Black Jack) plays the younger sister Haruka

• Shingo Katori (Lil' Red Riding Hood Cha-Cha, Friends: Mononoke Shima no Naki) plays the father Ichiro

• Jun Saitō (Labyrinth, live-action Let's Go Karaoke!, Trillion Game) plays the eldest son Kōtarō

• Riisa Naka (The Girl Who Leapt Through Time, live-action Cells at Work!) plays the mother Shizuka

Tôichirô Rutô (live-action Violence Action, G Men, Ossan's Love ) is directing the film based on a script by Europe Kikaku 's Makoto Ueda ( The Tatami Galaxy , Night is Short, Walk On Girl , Penguin Highway ). Yuzu performs the film's theme song "Kore mo Seishun da" (This is Also Youth).

The film will open in Japan on January 8, a delay from the film's originally planned fall 2026 opening.

Nakama launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in September 2020 and ended the series in Weekly Shonen Jump in February 2023. Shueisha published the 11th and final compiled book volume in July 2023. Viz Media is also publishing the manga in compiled volume form digitally.

Nakama previously published the Isobe Isobee Monogatari ~Ukiyo wa Tsurai yo~ manga in Weekly Shonen Jump from October 2013 to October 2017. The manga inspired two net anime series and a stage play.

title: Sora Karin, Kentaro Harada Launch The Pit of Darkness Manga
content:
MANGA Plus describes the manga:

“The Pit of Darkness”—an empty void that wipes anything thrown into it off the face of the Earth. Kasuga, a boy often taken advantage of by his peers for his diligent nature, happens upon a huge, bottomless pit during a field trip cleaning with his class. After accidentally dropping "something" inside, he realizes the pit possesses a strange power to... distort reality?!

Karin and Harada previously collaborated on the Enkan no Emotions manga, which was serialized in Shueisha 's Tonari no Young Jump website from November 2024 to January 30 earlier this year. Shueisha released the manga's fifth and final compiled book volume on March 18.

Karin and Merou Meiji 's The Archangel of Death ( Dantō no Archange ) manga was serialized in Coamix 's Comic Tatan website from March 2022 to November 2023. Coamix released five volumes for the manga. MangaPlaza releases the manga in English.

Harada and Mikumo Seto 's Villain Actor launched in Coamix 's Monthly Comic Zenon magazine in July 2022, and ended in October 2023. Coamix published three compiled book volumes for the manga. Titan Manga released all three volumes in English.

title: Precure Franchise Gets Spinoff TV Anime Dual Shadow ~Precure Villain Heroines~
content:
Toei Animation announced on Tuesday that the Precure franchise will receive a television anime spinoff titled Dual Shadow ~Precure Villain Heroines~ that will premiere next year. Unlike most of the previous spinoffs in the franchise , the new anime will feature an original story and characters.

Since the villain character Higashi Setsuna/Eas in 2009's Fresh Precure! became the hero Cure Passion, the Precure franchise has had a tradition of villains turning into heroes.

The Star Detective Precure! anime, the 23rd and latest main television anime in the franchise , debuted on February 1, and is ongoing. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in North America, Central America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and CIS.

Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! — opened in Japan on September 18, and ranked at #3 in its opening weekend. The film sold 358,000 tickets to earn 446 million yen (about US$2.82 million) in its first three days.

Toei Animation recently produced two 20th anniversary projects for the franchise . The Power of Hope: Precure Full Bloom television anime debuted in October 2023, and was a sequel to Yes! Precure 5 featuring the cast as adults. Mahō Tsukai Precure!!: MIRAI DAYS debuted in January 2025, and was a sequel to Witchy Pretty Cure!

title: Itsuwari no Kenta Manga Ends Next Chapter
content:
The December issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine announced on Monday that Yasushi Baba 's Itsuwari no Kenta (The Fake Centaur) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on November 26.

The story revolves around novice adventurer Ren who finds himself defending a spirit and its forgotten shrine from demons with the help of a sacred beast unicorn. As the two lay on the brink of death, inspiration strikes the spirit.

Baba launched the series in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in December 2025. Kodansha shipped the second compiled book volume on October 8.

Baba ended The Ride-On King on October 24. The series launched in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in May 2018.

Defunct publisher Sol Press had licensed the manga. The company only released the first volume in July 2019.

Baba ended his Golosseum manga in December 2017. Kodansha USA Publishing has released the six-volume manga in North America.

title: 3 New Anime to Watch If You Miss 2000s Anime
content:
The 2000s were the era when anime began to enter the mainstream, with several series emerging during this period, including what would eventually become known as the Big Three. It was an era defined by shonen anime, which ultimately shaped its identity. These series weren’t overly dark or focused on being modern, yet they still offered intriguing narratives.

This is exactly what One Piece , Bleach , and Naruto delivered at the time. While many anime since then have tried to capture the same vibe, three anime from 2026 perfectly recreate that era. From rowdy shonen energy and a mix of classic shonen clichés to a successor to a 2000s masterpiece, these are three anime you shouldn’t miss.

3) Psyren

Psyren is the perfect Fall 2026 anime that captures the vibe of 2000s anime, as the manga itself dates back to 2007. It was one of the shonen series that was axed shortly after reaching 100 chapters, bringing its story to a premature end. However, the dedication of its fans has finally led to an anime adaptation, and the studio has done a great job of making it feel like a 2000s anime while retaining a modern touch. Still, it is the series’ core elements that perfectly capture that retro vibe.

The protagonist, Ageha Yoshina, is the kind of rowdy shonen hero who feels remarkably similar to Ichigo from Bleach . The story begins with the protagonist receiving a phone call in a telephone booth, inviting him to take on a challenge in a new world that is eventually revealed to be an apocalyptic landscape with a game-like structure. Psyren is the perfect blend of modern and 2000s anime that fans will undoubtedly love watching in 2026.

2) Black Torch

Psyren isn’t the only series to receive a revival through an anime adaptation in 2026 . Black Torch is another anime that stems from a cancelled shonen manga. The source material had only 19 chapters before it came to an end, and the 12-episode anime adaptation perfectly captures its entire narrative. The series embraces classic shonen clichés, and Black Torch does it well.

With a protagonist who is just as rowdy as a classic shonen hero while sharing similarities with Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s Yuji, the anime delivers the perfect blend of old and modern shonen vibes. However, the main reason it feels so much like a 2000s anime is its striking similarities to Naruto , thanks to their many shared elements. Black Torch is a concise anime that captures what shonen series, especially those from the 2000s, are all about while still feeling modern.

1) Daemons of the Shadow Realm

One of the most famous anime of the 2000s, Fullmetal Alchemist emerged as one of the defining series of an era when anime was entering the mainstream. It was a masterpiece that continues to hold its reputation to this day. This is why Daemons of the Shadow Realm , the second series from the original author’s creator, is the perfect successor to Fullmetal Alchemist , capturing all the elements that made the classic so memorable.

With Daemons of the Shadow Realm also being produced by Bones Film, the anime visually resembles Fullmetal Alchemist . Its premise revolves around the bond between siblings, specifically twins, while its fantastical elements incorporate the Japanese spiritual themes that remain popular in anime today. There honestly couldn’t be a better pick among 2026 anime to capture the perfect 2000s vibe while still feeling fresh and modern enough to keep viewers engaged without getting bored.

title: Uoyama's Kimi to Issho ni Kayoitai Manga Ends on November 13
content:
This year's 21st issue of Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine announced on Friday that Uoyama 's Kimi to Issho ni Kayoitai ( I Want to Go to School With You ) manga will end in its next chapter on November 13.

The story follows bully victim Seita, who is invited by his childhood friend Mitsuru to apply to a private high school run entirely by students. Seita passes the entrance exams, but in a twist of fate, discovers Mitsuru fails. When he discovers the true reason behind MItsuru's rejection, he vows to seek justice for his childhood friend.

Uoyama launched the series in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in July 2025. Hakusensha shipped the second compiled book volume on May 29.

Uoyama launched the Kogure Kyōdai no Tomurai Kissa ( Kogure Sister & Brother's Requiem Cafe ) in Shinchosha 's Kurage Bunch website in January 2024, and ended it in January 2025. Shinchosha published the manga's third and final volume in May 2025.

Uoyama launched the Love's in Sight! ( Yankee-kun to Hakujō Girl ) manga on pixiv , Nico Nico Seiga , and Manga Hack in June 2018, and ended it in February 2022. Kodansha published the manga's eighth and final volume in May 2022. Viz Media licensed the manga, and released the manga's eighth volume in September 2024.

contentBlocks.text: This year's 21st issue of Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine announced on Friday that Uoyama 's Kimi to Issho ni Kayoitai ( I Want to Go to School With You ) manga will end in its next chapter on November 13.

The story follows bully victim Seita, who is invited by his childhood friend Mitsuru to apply to a private high school run entirely by students. Seita passes the entrance exams, but in a twist of fate, discovers Mitsuru fails. When he discovers the true reason behind MItsuru's rejection, he vows to seek justice for his childhood friend.
Uoyama launched the series in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in July 2025. Hakusensha shipped the second compiled book volume on May 29.

Uoyama launched the Kogure Kyōdai no Tomurai Kissa ( Kogure Sister & Brother's Requiem Cafe ) in Shinchosha 's Kurage Bunch website in January 2024, and ended it in January 2025. Shinchosha published the manga's third and final volume in May 2025.

Uoyama launched the Love's in Sight! ( Yankee-kun to Hakujō Girl ) manga on pixiv , Nico Nico Seiga , and Manga Hack in June 2018, and ended it in February 2022. Kodansha published the manga's eighth and final volume in May 2022. Viz Media licensed the manga, and released the manga's eighth volume in September 2024.
